C1193.title: Shunyi Procuratorate Handles Shen XX's SMS Bombing Program Case
C1193.summary: In June 2023, Shen XX rented an SMS bombing program via an overseas messaging app, integrated it with a self-built bot to create an 'SMS bombing bot', and placed it in a chat group for paid use. Users in the group recharged and sent commands, and the bot automatically executed the bombing.
